text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: service/redwood-inference – p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m (rule: svc_p95_high)
alex: seeing a spike in p95 and a bunch of downstream 504s. paging went to me and jamal.
maria: I’m pulling traces now, looks correlated with a rollout to dedicated-capacity yesterday.
jamal: confirmed. Batching rate dropped, CPU on host-gpu-03 jumped. Might be kernel fallback on quantized model.
alex: is this customer impacting? any error budgets breached?
jamal: a few clients reported timeouts, small percentage but external-facing endpoints. error budget at 86% for the org.
sre-lead: prioritize mitigation: reduce load -> fail open to smaller model variant, mute noisy infra alert, and start dashboard build for postmortem.
pat: assign me to the dashboard ticket. I can add golden signals panels and drilldowns.
alex: mitigation plan: 1) route read-heavy traffic to model-x-small 2) enable fallback region us-west-2 3) temporarily raise svc_p95_high threshold to 1500ms to reduce noise while we investigate.
maria: +1 for fallback. For the rule change, we should do a short-lived override in Grafana alerting. I'll prepare the patch.
jamal: SQL snippet to check affected requests:
```
SELECT count(*) as c, model_variant, status
FROM requests
WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY model_variant, status
ORDER BY c DESC
```
alex: results show top 3 models by traffic: redwood-4b-16k, redwood-3b-8k, model-x-small (low). fallbacks should absorb ~40% of read path.
sre-lead: okay go for the fallback and the temporary threshold bump. maria, can you also add a rate limiter rule to avoid amplification?
maria: yes. I’ll add a short-term circuit breaker at 200 RPS per host for the affected pool. putting it in config now.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260315-17 created (severity: 2). Pager duty runbook linked: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra-p95>
alex: handoff: I have to drop at 22:45 UTC. jamal will take next 2 hours, then maria will take overnight.
jamal: taking over. noted actions: fallback routing, temporary threshold, circuit breaker. I’ll monitor for 30m.
pat: dashboard plan for retro: panels to add — overall request rate, p50/p95/p99 latencies, error counts, model_variant heatmap, GPU util by host, request queue length, KV cache hit ratio, tail-latency scatter, and a drilldown link to traces and logs.
pat: mock panel list (to put in the ticket):
- Golden signals overview row (latency/errors/throughput/saturation)
- Per-model p95 heatmap
- Per-region failover events
- Alert noise counter (alerts fired / suppressed)
- Runbook link + incident timeline panel
- Drilldown: click a bar -> open traces filtered by model_variant
pat: I’ll include a template for annotations so we can mark the deployment at 21:37 UTC and the fallback at 21:50 UTC.
jamal: one more: add a panel that shows batching efficiency (tokens per batch) — that helped us detect the drop.
alex: agreed. Also include a small query to detect kernel fallback events from node logs (grep term: "kernel-fallback"), we had several host-level fallbacks.
maria: quick PR for alert override: in grafana-alerts repo
```
# temp override
- name: svc_p95_high_override
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job)) > 1.5
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```
maria: will land with 30min TTL and add a follow-up to revert.
sre-lead: don’t forget to log customer impact in the incident ticket: list affected customers, when we applied fallback, and any retries we saw.
jamal: logging note: I’ll collect sample request IDs and paste to the ticket in the next 15m.
alex: alert tuning follow-ups (to triage after incident):
- lower sensitivity on low-traffic models (noise)
- add suppression window around deploys for 10m
- add composite alert that requires both latency spike and errors > 1% to page
- create dashboard template for postmortems (pat owns)
pat: creating ticket INFRA-4792: "Grafana retro dashboard for INC-20260315-17" — linking here: <https://redwood.internal/infra/issues/4792>
pat: ETA to initial dashboard mock: 48 hours. will add checkboxes for panel ownership.
sre-lead: sounds good. once dashboard is up, we’ll use it in the retro to tune alert rules permanently.
jamal: current status: latency decreasing after fallback, GPU util back to normal on host-gpu-03. keeping monitoring on for 1h.
alex: I muted svc_p95_high paging for the affected rule group and left it to alert as quiet for dashboards only.
maria: PR merged for circuit breaker and the grafana override is in place with TTL.
pat: added initial panels to INFRA-4792 backlog with queries and mock screenshot links.
oncall-bot: INC-20260315-17 status: acknowledged by jamal. cc: @sre-lead
alex: thanks team. jamal, ping if it looks like this will need more than the overnight handoff. otherwise I’ll add notes to the ticket from my side before sign-off.
jamal: will do. marking as monitored.
sre-lead: follow-up actions assigned: INFRA-4792 (pat), INFRA-4793 (maria: alert tuning), INFRA-4794 (alex/jamal: customer impact list). Please update tickets in 24h. :white_check_mark:
